cohort: 15,218 live birth singleton pregnancies by primigravida mothers aged 20-29 years in Lebanon from 2004-2008
finding: Advanced paternal age (APA) was associated with increased odds of low birth weight and Cesarean section deliveries compared to fathers aged 30-35 years.
mod_finding: Cesarean section deliveries were more common in infants born to fathers of advanced paternal age and fathers aged 35-39 compared to those less than 30 years old.
